name: CHIMAPHILA UMBELLATA
key_symptoms: Pain in left frontal protuberance. Halo about the light. Itching of eyelids. Stabbing pain in left eye with lachrymation.
Feeling of a band above left knee.
guiding_symptoms: Pain in left frontal protuberance. Halo about the light. Itching of eyelids. Stabbing pain in left eye with lachrymation.
Feeling of a band above left knee.

worse: from sitting on cold stones or pavements

head_symptoms: Pain in left frontal protuberance. Halo about the light. Itching of eyelids. Stabbing pain in left eye with lachrymation.
urinary_symptoms: Urging to urinate. Urine turbid, offensive, containing ropy or bloody mucus, and depositing a copious sediment. Burning and scalding during micturition, and straining afterwards. Must strain before flow comes. Scanty urine. Acute prostatitis, retention, and feeling of a ball in perineum (Cann ind). Fluttering in region of kidney. Sugar in urine. Unable to urinate without standing with feet wide apart and body inclined forward.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Feeling of a band above left knee.
complementary_remedies: sensation of swelling in arm pits

source.title: CHIMAPHILA UMBELLATA - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
